items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: you've explained to me some of your thoughts over how you felt about Tommy Dorsey and you named some other great white trombone players, Jack Jenney and Miff Mole

ctx.x: So, really, my inspiration really was Claude Jones from the beginning.

Well, in looking back at this in retrospect, and you know the era we came up in and the social situation in America -- we were talking in the beginning before black and white players played together, but in this big auditory world of music where we don't see each other but we hear each other and we respect each other for how we sound -- you've explained to me some of your thoughts over how you felt about Tommy Dorsey and you named some other great white trombone players, Jack Jenney and Miff Mole and these, what…
